name: Shri Siddhivinayak Ganpati Devasthan Trust Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation at Siddhatek's Siddhivinayak Ganpati (Astavinayak temple) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. Siddhatek is the most isolated Astavinayak temple (Karha river island), so the trust accommodation is effectively the only option.
